questionThisAnswers: Does the LITERAL user command `dsh plugin --profile web add github:HaroldZ32/My-Power-Dsh` complete on a clean machine and mount, and are the objective's five clauses each substantiated?
verdict: YES — measured 2026-09-28/29 in a clean ubuntu:24.04 container against the live GitHub repository, on the released default branch (master, tag v0.11.6).

liveLaneProof.result: ok=true, 44 passed, 0 failed, 3 NULL (two not applicable in one-click mode, one the credential-bound LLM turn), exit 0
liveLaneProof.whatItAsserts: the install completes, the profile records the git spec and @mpd-dsh/mpd in dsh.profile.bundles, the installed tree carries the patch layers and built dists, and the profile MOUNTS: rows activate, tools register, the TUI boots on a real PTY, the harness's own session store records agentPreset=mpd

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: an UNTRACKED pnpm-workspace.yaml at the repo root carried pnpm's own `allowBuilds` template; it entered the Docker build context and pnpm's ancestor-config discovery read it for an install whose cwd sat there
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: removed; Dockerfile.dockerignore excludes pnpm-workspace.yaml / pnpm-lock.yaml / .npmrc / .pnpmfile.cjs; the entrypoint asserts their absence in copy.contextFiltered; four new --self-test arms pin both halves

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.symptom: the same three packages pulled from a RELEASED install
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: `github:<owner>/<repo>` resolves the repository's DEFAULT BRANCH: it served `master`, which still declared dsh-better-sidebar as a dependency plus the two binary tools as optionalDependencies — i.e. the pre-wave manifest
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: released the wave to the default branch (v0.11.2, tag + push) and recorded the rule in AGENTS.md §8/§11

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.symptom: [ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP] Exotic dependency "@mpd-dsh/mpd" (resolved via git-repository) is not allowed in subdependencies
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: our own manifest declared `"@mpd-dsh/mpd": "github:HaroldZ32/My-Power-Dsh"` in `dependencies`, so a git-hosted install resolved the bundle as a dependency OF ITSELF
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: removed (nothing resolves the bundle by name from inside the repo — Node's self-reference still resolves @mpd-dsh/mpd/package.json through the manifest's name + exports)

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.symptom: install succeeded, run still failed on install.profileDep
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: the assertion accepted only the `git+…` URL shape, while the lane drives the documented `github:` shorthand
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: the arm accepts `oneclick:github:*` and the driver's offline self-test pins it

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.symptom: bun run test:qa red on tui-distribution.ts: "distribution.version must match package.json (0.11.4)"
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: the release version lives in THREE carriers (package.json, dsh-plugin.json, dsh-distribution.json) and only the first was bumped; a bulk edit then wrote a root `version` into the distribution descriptor whose version is at `distribution.version`, and the new gate's root-first reader accepted the stray key (false PASS)
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: all three carriers synced; verify:manifest gained a VERSION-COHERENCE rule with an EXPLICIT key path per carrier and stray-root detection; a sixth --self-test arm whose control is the real manifest; AGENTS.md §11 step 1 names the three files

defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.cause: the version-coherence rewrite replaced a region and took the JSDoc above two functions with it
defectsFoundByDrivingTheLiteralCommand.fix: restored; the gate is green again on the release line

evidence: 345 .ts / 1 .mjs in the wave scope (the .mjs is the generated visual-qa bundle); 155 .mjs + 3 .js deleted, 162 new .ts
tsconfig.json has strict: true and the root tsgo --noEmit reports 0 diagnostics over packages/*/{src,test,self-fix-tests}, scripts/, skills/*/scripts/, docker/, tests/, templates/, extensions/
bun run verify:comments PASS — every declaration carries a precise comment and every named function its parameter/return types
AGENTS.md §2 and §8 carry the binding mounting contract: an independent package referenced by the profile; never a DSH source edit, never a hand-written profile, never a row pushed into DSH_HOME
the live lane's mount assertions (rows active, tools registered, TUI booted, agentPreset=mpd in the session store) are the runtime proof, not a composition dump
the literal command passes in a clean ubuntu:24.04 against the live GitHub repo: 44 passed / 0 failed (evidence/docker/client-install-oneclick/2026-09-28T23-39-39Z)
npm publish --dry-run passes (@mpd-dsh/mpd 0.11.6, 7.6 MB packed / 1134 files) for the registry path

bun run verify:manifest --pack PASS: no `cordis` in dependencies / peerDependencies / optionalDependencies (by NAME), none of the declared scripts carries preinstall / install / postinstall / prepare, and npm's own packlist carries every row-referenced path
the gate grew a VERSION-COHERENCE rule and a sixth self-test arm in this round; 6/6 arms pass with clean controls

every QA boot used a temp DSH_HOME + sandbox HOME + sandboxed workspace; the real ~/.dsh profile was never written (its mtime+inode were stat-ed before and after the sandboxed install and are unchanged)

the real-machine verification is a real ubuntu:24.04 container driven by docker/docker-compose.yml (rootless Docker, SecurityOptions name=rootless); the driver now skips with a notice on a machine without rootless Docker and can be made fatal with --require-docker

releasesThisRound.carries: the TypeScript wave onto the default branch

knownUnfixedFindings: packages/mpd-config-plugin README's precedence table omits the L4 row-config layer
`agent_teams_*` error strings still name retired tool names (the plugin is not mounted)
skills/lsp-setup/scripts/verify-lsp.ts points at an upstream `packages/lsp-tools-mcp/` path that does not exist here
packages/mpd-modelchain-plugin/README.md documents upstream role ids rather than the functional names
the gitee mirror (https://gitee.com/nop_chip/my-power-dsh) is behind GitHub and was not pushed
